course_title: 📱 تطبيقات الموبايل للصغار - MIT Mobile App
recap_subtitle: Hello, creative mobile app developers! Let's explore the awesome layouts, buttons, and sensors we used to build real Android applications on our phones. Here is a recap of our 12 amazing sessions:

sessions.title: Session 1: Getting Started with App Inventor
targets: Place a button on the virtual viewer screen
sessions.project: Designing our first simple screen with interactive buttons!

sessions.title: Session 2: The 'Say It' Text-to-Speech App
targets: Connect inputs to speech sound triggers
sessions.project: Say It! - An app that reads aloud whatever secret message you type into the textbox!

sessions.title: Session 3: Simple Math Calculator App
targets: Use 2 text boxes for number inputs
sessions.project: Simple Calculator - Enter two numbers, press plus or minus, and see the correct answer instantly!

sessions.title: Session 4: My Favorite Animal Switcher
sessions.project: My Favorite Animal - Press animal buttons to switch pictures to lions, cats, or panda bears!

sessions.title: Session 5: Let's Paint Canvas Drawing App
targets: Use the Canvas component for coordinate drawing
Change line widths and paint brush colors
sessions.project: Let's Paint! - Draw lines on your phone screen, pick your favorite brush colors, and sketch master arts!

sessions.title: Session 6: Arranging Layouts & Alignments
sessions.project: Polishing the Painter app with a horizontal palette layout at the bottom!

sessions.title: Session 7: The Math Quiz App (Setup Screens)
targets: Set up Screen1, Screen2, and Screen3 workspaces
sessions.project: Math Quiz Screen Setup - Creating multiple interactive screens for starting and loading quiz questions!

sessions.title: Session 8: Passing Data Between Screens
targets: Carry scores or statistics between screens
blocks: open another screen with start value
sessions.project: Math Quiz Game Rules - Keeping score of player answers and displaying a winning result page at the end!

sessions.title: Session 9: Spell My Name Aloud App
targets: Parse letters of a typed name input
sessions.project: Spell My Name! - Type in your name and hear the phone spell it out loud, letter by letter!

sessions.title: Session 10: Pop the Balloon Game!
targets: Use Clock timer components to randomize positions
Increase score count on sprites clicks
sessions.project: Pop the Balloon! - Pop the balloon before the timer ticks and randomizes its position to gain high scores!

sessions.title: Session 11: Accelerometer Shaking Sensors
targets: Use the Accelerometer physical movement sensor
sessions.project: Magic Shake Eraser - Shake your Android phone physically in your hand to clear and erase canvas drawings!

sessions.title: Session 12: Rock, Paper, Scissors Game
targets: Make random selection from lists for virtual AI player
Check win, lose, and tie states
sessions.project: Rock-Paper-Scissors! - Tap buttons to play against the computer AI and see who gets crowned the absolute champion!
